54	## Current state
55	
56	`ActionRunnerService` owns active runs in Electron. When a run ends, `finalizeRun` removes it from `runs` and `runEvents`, then retains only its terminal result for `wait`.
57	
58	Android keeps run state in `ActionRunRegistry`. After remote-control WebSocket loss, `RemoteConnectionService` replaces `RemoteControlStorageService`. `ActionRunRegistry` subscribes through the replacement bridge and calls `loadActiveActionRunEvents`, which returns histories for runs still active in Electron.
59	
60	Wrong sequence:
61	
62	1. Android receives a running or waiting run.
63	2. WebSocket closes. Electron continues the run.
64	3. Run ends before Android recovery loads active runs. Electron removes its active run and event history.
65	4. Recovery returns no events for that run. `ActionRunRegistry` does not reconcile locally active runs missing from the recovery result, so Android keeps stale interactive state.
66	5. User sends, finishes, stops, restarts, or answers through stale `runId`.
67	6. Electron `requireRun` cannot find that completed run and throws `Unknown action run`.
68	
69	`Remote-control connection was replaced` is expected rejection from retired storage during transport replacement. `External change ignored ... because the file has unsaved local edits` is separate conflict protection: watcher found an external write while renderer still owned an unsaved edit. Neither message should be treated as proof that action itself failed.
70	
71	## implementation details
72	
73	- Make reconnect recovery authoritative. An **authoritative recovery snapshot** is Electron state used to decide which renderer runs remain interactive, not only a stream of events to merge.
74	- Extend action bridge recovery contract so Electron returns active run event histories plus terminal results for renderer run IDs that may have ended during disconnect. Keep terminal recovery results available to every reconnecting client for a bounded lifetime; recovery must not consume result needed by another client.
75	- In `ActionRunRegistry`, capture locally active run IDs when bridge changes. Subscribe first, then load recovery snapshot. Buffer live events during load, apply snapshot, apply buffered events by sequence, and reconcile every captured ID:
76	  - keep run when snapshot or buffered events show it active;
77	  - apply returned terminal result, resolve local waiter, clear approvals/questions/drafts, and release run when Electron reports completion;
78	  - end local interactivity with explicit `Action run state was lost during reconnection` failure when Electron reports neither active nor terminal state.
79	- Do not map `Unknown action run` to success and do not make send, answer, finish, restart, or cancel broadly idempotent. Those operations must still reject genuinely invalid run IDs.
80	- Preserve current run-event sequence deduplication. A terminal event received live during recovery wins over older snapshot events.
81	- Include remote method name in rejected request context, while preserving Electron error as cause, so future telemetry identifies whether stale operation was send, finish, stop, restart, approval, or question.
82	- Keep project watcher conflict handling unchanged. This fix repairs action-run recovery only; it must not overwrite dirty editor content or suppress genuine external-change warnings.
83	- Add focused tests in action runner, action bridge/dispatch, remote-control storage, remote connection, and action-run registry. Cover disconnect before terminal event, completion during snapshot loading, live/snapshot ordering, multiple reconnecting clients, missing recovery state, and real unknown IDs.
84	
85	## acceptance criteria
86	
87	- When WebSocket closes while action is running or waiting, Android reconnects and shows current Electron state without duplicate events.
88	- When action completes, fails, or is cancelled during disconnect, reconnect applies actual terminal result and removes all interactive controls for old `runId`.
89	- User action after recovery never sends send, finish, stop, restart, approval, or question request for run that Electron reported terminal or lost.
90	- Completion racing with recovery snapshot resolves once; terminal state cannot revert to running or waiting.
91	- Two clients reconnecting after same terminal run can both recover its result; one client does not consume recovery state needed by other.
92	- Genuine invalid run IDs still fail. Telemetry names attempted remote method and retains `Unknown action run` as underlying Electron error.
93	- Reconnect does not suppress watcher conflicts and never replaces unsaved renderer edits with external file content.
94	- Focused desktop and app tests, app typecheck, and linters pass.

556	                const importedFiles = await this.importExternalCardFiles(projectFilesResult.value.files, workingFolder)
557	                if (!this.shouldApplyProjectLoad(project, projectLoadToken)) return
558	
559	                const importedPaths = new Set(importedFiles.map((file) => file.path))
560	                const removedImportedPaths = projectFilesResult.value.files
561	                    .filter((file) => !importedPaths.has(file.path))
562	                    .map((file) => file.path)
563	                const remainingFiles = removeFilesByPath(this.dependencies.files(), removedImportedPaths)
564	                nextFiles = mergeFiles(importedFiles, remainingFiles)
565	                projectFilesLoaded = true
566	            } catch (error) {
567	                reportWorkspaceError(backgroundProjectLoadFailureMessage(error))
568	                telemetryService.captureError(error)
569	            }
570	        } else {
571	            reportWorkspaceError(backgroundProjectLoadFailureMessage(projectFilesResult.reason))
572	            telemetryService.captureError(projectFilesResult.reason)
573	        }
574	
575	        const currentRepositoryFiles = this.dependencies.snapshot()?.repositoryFiles ?? []
576	        const repositoryFiles = repositoryFilesResult.status === 'fulfilled'
577	            ? repositoryFilesResult.value
578	            : currentRepositoryFiles
579	        if (repositoryFilesResult.status === 'rejected') {
580	            reportOptionalProjectLoadFailure('Repository file index', repositoryFilesResult.reason)
581	        }
582	        if (!projectFilesLoaded && repositoryFilesResult.status === 'rejected') return
583	        if (!this.shouldApplyProjectLoad(project, projectLoadToken)) return
584	
585	        this.dependencies.mergeBackgroundProjectFiles(nextFiles, workingFolder, repositoryFiles)
586	        await this.ensureCardInternalIds()
587	        await this.dependencies.migrateAgentLogReferences()
588	        if (projectFilesLoaded) this.dependencies.markFullProjectLoaded()
589	        this.dependencies.dispatchChanged()
590	    }

592	    private shouldApplyProjectLoad(project: ProjectReference, projectLoadToken: number) {
593	        return this.dependencies.isCurrentLoad(project, projectLoadToken)
594	    }
595	
596	    private startProjectWatch() {
597	        this.stopProjectWatch()
598	        const currentProject = this.dependencies.project()
599	        const storage = this.dependencies.storage()
600	        if (!currentProject || !storage?.watchProject) return
601	
602	        this.watchCleanup = storage.watchProject(
603	            currentProject,
604	            (event) => this.handleProjectWatchEvent(event),
605	            () => void this.resynchronizeProjectAfterWatchRestore(),
606	            (error) => reportOptionalProjectLoadFailure('Project file watching', error),
607	        )
608	    }
609	
610	    private async resynchronizeProjectAfterWatchRestore() {
611	        const { config, storage } = this.dependencies.requireDependencies()
612	        const currentProject = this.dependencies.project()
613	        if (!currentProject) return
614	
615	        try {
616	            const projectFiles = await storage.loadProject(currentProject, config.projectFolder)
617	            if (this.dependencies.project() !== currentProject) return
618	
619	            const currentFiles = this.dependencies.files().filter((file) => isProjectMarkdownPath(file.path, config.projectFolder))
620	            const currentFilesByPath = new Map(currentFiles.map((file) => [file.path, file]))
621	            const loadedPaths = new Set<string>()
622	            for (const file of projectFiles.files) {
623	                if (!isProjectMarkdownPath(file.path, config.projectFolder)) continue
624	
625	                loadedPaths.add(file.path)
626	                const currentFile = currentFilesByPath.get(file.path)
627	                if (currentFile?.content === file.content) continue
628	
629	                this.handleProjectWatchEvent({
630	                    changeKind: currentFile ? 'changed' : 'added',
631	                    path: file.path,
632	                })
633	            }
634	            for (const file of currentFiles) {
635	                if (!loadedPaths.has(file.path)) this.handleProjectWatchEvent({ changeKind: 'removed', path: file.path })
636	            }
637	        } catch (error) {
638	            reportOptionalProjectLoadFailure('Project resynchronization', error)
639	        }
640	    }
641	
642	    private handleProjectWatchEvent(event: ProjectWatchEvent) {
643	        if (mergeConflictService.isConflictedPath(event.path)) {
644	            this.scheduleMergeConflictVerification()
645	            return
646	        }
647	        this.dependencies.updateRepositoryFile(event)
648	        this.dependencies.dispatchRepositoryChanged(event)
649	        if (event.path === PROJECT_CONFIG_PATH) {
650	            void this.reloadProjectConfigFromWatch()
651	            return
652	        }
653	        const { config } = this.dependencies.requireDependencies()
654	        if (isActionDefinitionPath(event.path, config.actionsFolder)) {
655	            const change: ActionReloadChange = this.dependencies.commitPathsInFlight().has(event.path)
656	                ? { origin: 'local', path: event.path, revision: actionService.getPublicationRevision(event.path) }
657	                : { origin: 'external', path: event.path }
658	            this.scheduleActionReload(change)
659	            return
660	        }
661	
662	        if (!isProjectMarkdownPath(event.path, config.projectFolder)) return
663	        if (this.dependencies.commitPathsInFlight().has(event.path)) return
664	
665	        this.scheduleMarkdownReload(event)
666	    }

668	    private async reloadProjectConfigFromWatch() {
669	        const { storage } = this.dependencies.requireDependencies()
670	        const currentProject = this.dependencies.project()
671	        if (!currentProject) return
672	
673	        try {
674	            configService.loadProjectConfig(await storage.loadProjectConfig(currentProject))
675	        } catch (error) {
676	            reportOptionalProjectLoadFailure('Project configuration reload', error)
677	        }
678	    }

680	    private scheduleActionReload(change: ActionReloadChange) {
681	        this.actionReloadChangesByPath.set(change.path, change)
682	        this.clearActionReloadTimeout()
683	        this.actionReloadTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
684	            void this.reloadActionsFromCurrentProject()
685	        }, ACTION_RELOAD_DEBOUNCE_MS)
686	    }

688	    private scheduleMergeConflictVerification() {
689	        this.clearMergeConflictVerifyTimeout()
690	        this.mergeConflictVerifyTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
691	            void this.verifyMergeConflictState()
692	        }, MERGE_CONFLICT_VERIFY_DEBOUNCE_MS)
693	    }

695	    private clearMergeConflictVerifyTimeout() {
696	        if (this.mergeConflictVerifyTimeout === null) return
697	
698	        window.clearTimeout(this.mergeConflictVerifyTimeout)
699	        this.mergeConflictVerifyTimeout = null
700	    }
701

703	        this.clearMergeConflictVerifyTimeout()
704	        try {
705	            await mergeConflictService.verifyCurrentSession()
706	        } catch (error) {
707	            dialogService.error(error, { fallbackMessage: 'Could not verify merge conflict state after file change' })
708	        }
709	    }
710	
711	    private clearActionReloadTimeout() {
712	        if (this.actionReloadTimeout === null) return
713	
714	        window.clearTimeout(this.actionReloadTimeout)
715	        this.actionReloadTimeout = null
716	    }
717	
718	    private scheduleMarkdownReload(event: ProjectWatchEvent) {
719	        const pendingRemovalTimeout = this.markdownRemovalTimeoutsByPath.get(event.path)
720	        if (pendingRemovalTimeout !== undefined) {
721	            window.clearTimeout(pendingRemovalTimeout)
722	            this.markdownRemovalTimeoutsByPath.delete(event.path)
723	        }
724	
725	        if (event.changeKind === 'removed') {
726	            const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
727	                this.markdownRemovalTimeoutsByPath.delete(event.path)
728	                this.markdownReloadEventsByPath.set(event.path, event)
729	                this.scheduleMarkdownReloadBatch()
730	            }, MARKDOWN_REMOVAL_GRACE_MS)
731	            this.markdownRemovalTimeoutsByPath.set(event.path, timeout)
732	            return
733	        }
734	
735	        this.markdownReloadEventsByPath.set(event.path, event)
736	        this.scheduleMarkdownReloadBatch()
737	    }
738	
739	    private scheduleMarkdownReloadBatch() {
740	        this.clearMarkdownReloadTimeout()
741	        this.markdownReloadTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
742	            void this.reloadMarkdownFilesFromWatchEvents()
743	        }, MARKDOWN_RELOAD_DEBOUNCE_MS)
744	    }
745	
746	    private clearMarkdownReloadTimeout() {
747	        if (this.markdownReloadTimeout === null) return
748	
749	        window.clearTimeout(this.markdownReloadTimeout)
750	        this.markdownReloadTimeout = null
751	    }
752	
753	    private clearMarkdownRemovalTimeouts() {
754	        this.markdownRemovalTimeoutsByPath.forEach((timeout) => window.clearTimeout(timeout))
755	        this.markdownRemovalTimeoutsByPath.clear()
756	    }
757	
758	    private async reloadMarkdownFilesFromWatchEvents() {
759	        const { commitBatcher, storage } = this.dependencies.requireDependencies()
760	        const currentProject = this.dependencies.project()
761	        if (!currentProject || !storage.loadFile) return
762	
763	        this.clearMarkdownReloadTimeout()
764	        const events = [...this.markdownReloadEventsByPath.values()]
765	        this.markdownReloadEventsByPath.clear()
766	        const updatedFiles: MarkdownFile[] = []
767	        const removedPaths: string[] = []
768	
769	        for (const event of events) {
770	            if (this.dependencies.commitPathsInFlight().has(event.path)) continue
771	            const loadedFile = event.changeKind === 'removed' ? null : await this.loadWatchedMarkdownFile(event)
772	            if (loadedFile && this.dependencies.matchesCurrentContent(loadedFile.path, loadedFile.content)) continue
773	            const dirtyOpenDocument = openFilesService.getRegisteredDocuments().some((document) => (
774	                document.kind === 'card' && document.path === event.path && document.dirty
775	            ))
776	            if (commitBatcher.hasPendingFile(event.path) || dirtyOpenDocument) {
777	                reportMarkdownWatchConflict(event.path)
778	                continue
779	            }
780	
781	            if (event.changeKind === 'removed') {
782	                removedPaths.push(event.path)
783	                continue
784	            }
785	
786	            if (!loadedFile) {
787	                if (event.changeKind === 'unknown') removedPaths.push(event.path)
788	                continue
789	            }
790	
791	            const currentFile = this.dependencies.files().find((file) => file.path === loadedFile.path)
792	            if (currentFile?.content === loadedFile.content) continue
793	
794	            updatedFiles.push(loadedFile)
795	        }
796	
797	        const removedPathSet = new Set(removedPaths)
798	        const watchedFiles = mergeFiles(
799	            this.dependencies.files().filter((file) => !removedPathSet.has(file.path)),
800	            updatedFiles,
801	        )
802	        const importedFiles = await this.importExternalCardFiles(watchedFiles, this.dependencies.requireDependencies().config.workingFolder)
803	        if (updatedFiles.length === 0 && removedPaths.length === 0 && importedFiles === watchedFiles) return
804	
805	        const { config } = this.dependencies.requireDependencies()
806	        const currentFiles = this.dependencies.files()
807	        const currentFilesByPath = new Map(currentFiles.map((file) => [file.path, file]))
808	        const importedPaths = new Set(importedFiles.map((file) => file.path))
809	        const changedFiles = importedFiles.filter((file) => {
810	            const currentFile = currentFilesByPath.get(file.path)
811	            return !currentFile || currentFile.content !== file.content || currentFile.sha !== file.sha
812	        })
813	        const deletedPaths = currentFiles.filter((file) => !importedPaths.has(file.path)).map((file) => file.path)
814	        this.dependencies.updateFiles(changedFiles, deletedPaths, config.workingFolder)
815	        await this.ensureCardInternalIds()
816	        await this.dependencies.migrateAgentLogReferences()
817	        this.dependencies.dispatchChanged()
818	    }
819	
820	    private async ensureCardInternalIds() {
821	        if (projectAccessService.getSnapshot()) return
822	
823	        await this.dependencies.ensureCardInternalIds()
824	    }
825	
826	    private async loadWatchedMarkdownFile(event: ProjectWatchEvent) {
827	        const { storage } = this.dependencies.requireDependencies()
828	        const currentProject = this.dependencies.project()
829	        if (!currentProject || !storage.loadFile) return null
830	
831	        try {
832	            return await storage.loadFile(currentProject, event.path)
833	        } catch (error) {
834	            if (event.changeKind === 'unknown' || event.changeKind === 'removed') return null
835	
836	            console.error('Failed to load watched markdown file', error)
837	
838	            return null
839	        }
840	    }
841	
842	    private async reloadActionsFromCurrentProject() {
843	        const { config, storage } = this.dependencies.requireDependencies()
844	        const currentProject = this.dependencies.project()
845	        if (!currentProject) return
846	
847	        const changes = [...this.actionReloadChangesByPath.values()]
848	        if (changes.length === 0) return
849	
850	        this.clearActionReloadTimeout()
851	        this.actionReloadChangesByPath.clear()
852	        const actionFiles = await storage.loadActionFiles(currentProject, config.actionsFolder)
853	        actionService.reloadFromFiles(actionFiles, changes)
854	        reportActionLoadIssues()
855	    }
856	}

1	import { AUTO_COMMIT_DELAY_MS, type CommitRequest, type MarkdownFile } from './data_types'
2	
3	import { markdownParsingService } from '../services/data/markdown_parsing_service'
4	import type { OpenDocumentSaveReference } from '../services/open_files_service'
5	import type { Card } from './data_types'
6	
7	type DelayId = number
8	
9	interface CommitBatcherOperations {
10	    commitFiles(request: CommitRequest): Promise<unknown>
11	    pushCommittedFiles(request: CommitRequest): Promise<unknown>
12	    requireCardByInternalId(internalId: string): Card
13	}
14	
15	export const COMMIT_BATCHER_FLUSH_FAILED_EVENT = 'flushFailed'
16	export const COMMIT_BATCHER_PENDING_CHANGED_EVENT = 'pendingChanged'
17	
18	interface PendingFileChange {
19	    change: CommitChange
20	    fromPath: string
21	    moveSource: boolean
22	    onCommitted?: (fromPath: string, toPath: string) => void
23	    onPersisted?: () => void
24	    saveReference?: OpenDocumentSaveReference
25	}
26	
27	export interface CommitFileChange extends MarkdownFile {
28	    onPersisted?: () => void
29	    saveReference?: OpenDocumentSaveReference
30	}
31	
32	export interface CommitCardChange {
33	    cardInternalId: string
34	    onPersisted?: () => void
35	    path: string
36	    saveReference?: OpenDocumentSaveReference
37	    targetPath?: string
38	}
39	
40	export type CommitChange = CommitFileChange | CommitCardChange
41	
42	function isCardChange(change: CommitChange): change is CommitCardChange {
43	    return 'cardInternalId' in change
44	}
45	
46	function changePath(change: CommitChange) {
47	    return isCardChange(change) ? change.targetPath ?? change.path : change.path
48	}
49	
50	interface SerializedChange {
51	    card: Card | null
52	    file: MarkdownFile
53	}
54	
55	function serializeChange(change: CommitChange, cardOperations: CommitBatcherOperations): SerializedChange {
56	    if (!isCardChange(change)) {
57	        const file = {
58	            content: change.content,
59	            ...(change.encoding ? { encoding: change.encoding } : {}),
60	            path: change.path,
61	            ...(change.sha ? { sha: change.sha } : {}),
62	        }
63	
64	        return { card: null, file }
65	    }
66	
67	    const card = cardOperations.requireCardByInternalId(change.cardInternalId)
68	    const file = { ...markdownParsingService.serializeCard(card), path: changePath(change) }
69	
70	    return { card, file }
71	}
72	
73	export class CommitBatcher extends EventTarget {
74	    private activeFlush: Promise<void> | null
75	    private automaticFlushDeferrals: number
76	    private readonly cardOperations: CommitBatcherOperations
77	    private readonly delayMs
78	    private pendingBranch: string | null
79	    private readonly pendingChanges
80	    private readonly pendingMessagesByPath
81	    private scheduledDelayId: DelayId | null
82	
83	    constructor(cardOperations: CommitBatcherOperations, delayMs = AUTO_COMMIT_DELAY_MS) {
84	        super()
85	        this.activeFlush = null
86	        this.automaticFlushDeferrals = 0
87	        this.cardOperations = cardOperations
88	        this.delayMs = delayMs
89	        this.pendingBranch = null
90	        this.pendingChanges = new Map<string, PendingFileChange>()
91	        this.pendingMessagesByPath = new Map<string, string[]>()
92	        this.scheduledDelayId = null
93	    }
94	
95	    schedule(branch: string, changes: CommitChange[], message: string) {
96	        this.pendingBranch = branch
97	        changes.forEach((change) => {
98	            const path = changePath(change)
99	            this.pendingChanges.set(path, {
100	                change,
101	                fromPath: path,
102	                moveSource: false,
103	                onPersisted: change.onPersisted,
104	                saveReference: change.saveReference,
105	            })
106	            this.addPendingMessage(path, message)
107	        })
108	
109	        this.scheduleFlush()
110	    }
111	
112	    schedulePathChange(
113	        branch: string,
114	        fromPath: string,
115	        change: CommitChange,
116	        message: string,
117	        onCommitted: (fromPath: string, toPath: string) => void,
118	        sourceExists = true,
119	    ) {
120	        this.pendingBranch = branch
121	        this.pendingChanges.set(fromPath, {
122	            change,
123	            fromPath,
124	            moveSource: sourceExists,
125	            onCommitted,
126	            onPersisted: change.onPersisted,
127	            saveReference: change.saveReference,
128	        })
129	        this.addPendingMessage(fromPath, message)
130	
131	        this.scheduleFlush()
132	    }
133	
134	    private scheduleFlush() {
135	        this.clearScheduledDelay()
136	        if (this.automaticFlushDeferrals > 0) {
137	            this.dispatchEvent(new Event(COMMIT_BATCHER_PENDING_CHANGED_EVENT))
138	            return
139	        }
140	        this.scheduledDelayId = window.setTimeout(this.createFlushCallback(), this.delayMs)
141	        this.dispatchEvent(new Event(COMMIT_BATCHER_PENDING_CHANGED_EVENT))
142	    }
143	
144	    /** Pauses timer-driven flushes while one caller adds fields that must share a card version. */
145	    deferAutomaticFlush() {
146	        this.automaticFlushDeferrals += 1
147	        this.clearScheduledDelay()
148	        let released = false
149	
150	        return () => {
151	            if (released) return
152	
153	            released = true
154	            this.automaticFlushDeferrals -= 1
155	            if (this.automaticFlushDeferrals === 0 && this.hasPending()) this.scheduleFlush()
156	        }
157	    }
158	
159	    hasPending() {
160	        return this.pendingChanges.size > 0 && this.pendingBranch !== null
161	    }
162	
163	    hasPendingFile(path: string) {
164	        return [...this.pendingChanges.values()].some(({ change, fromPath }) => (
165	            fromPath === path || changePath(change) === path
166	        ))
167	    }
168	
169	    discardPendingFile(path: string) {
170	        const entry = [...this.pendingChanges.entries()].find(([, { change, fromPath }]) => (
171	            fromPath === path || changePath(change) === path
172	        ))
173	        if (!entry) return
174	
175	        const [changeKey] = entry
176	        this.pendingChanges.delete(changeKey)
177	
178	        this.pendingMessagesByPath.delete(changeKey)
179	        if (this.pendingChanges.size === 0) {
180	            this.pendingBranch = null
181	            this.clearScheduledDelay()
182	        }
183	        this.dispatchEvent(new Event(COMMIT_BATCHER_PENDING_CHANGED_EVENT))
184	    }
185	
186	    async flush() {
187	        if (this.activeFlush) {
188	            await this.activeFlush
189	            if (this.hasPending()) await this.flush()
190	            return
191	        }
192	        if (!this.hasPending()) return
193	
194	        this.clearScheduledDelay()
195	        const pendingChanges = [...this.pendingChanges.values()]
196	        const serializedChanges = new Map(
197	            pendingChanges.map((change) => [change, serializeChange(change.change, this.cardOperations)]),
198	        )
199	        const files = pendingChanges
200	            .filter(({ moveSource }) => !moveSource)
201	            .map((change) => (serializedChanges.get(change) as SerializedChange).file)
202	        const moves = pendingChanges
203	            .filter(({ moveSource }) => moveSource)
204	            .map((change) => {
205	                const { file } = serializedChanges.get(change) as SerializedChange
206	
207	                return {
208	                    content: file.content,
209	                    ...(file.encoding ? { encoding: file.encoding } : {}),
210	                    fromPath: change.fromPath,
211	                    ...(file.sha ? { sha: file.sha } : {}),
212	                    toPath: file.path,
213	                }
214	            })
215	        const request = {
216	            branch: this.pendingBranch as string,
217	            files,
218	            message: this.createCommitMessage(),
219	            ...(moves.length > 0 ? { moves } : {}),
220	        }
221	
222	        this.activeFlush = this.commitSnapshot(request, pendingChanges, serializedChanges)
223	        try {
224	            await this.activeFlush
225	        } finally {
226	            this.activeFlush = null
227	        }
228	    }
229	
230	    private addPendingMessage(path: string, message: string) {
231	        const messages = this.pendingMessagesByPath.get(path) ?? []
232	        if (messages.includes(message)) return
233	
234	        this.pendingMessagesByPath.set(path, [...messages, message])
235	    }
236	
237	    private async commitSnapshot(
238	        request: CommitRequest,
239	        changes: PendingFileChange[],
240	        serializedChanges: Map<PendingFileChange, SerializedChange>,
241	    ) {
242	        await this.cardOperations.commitFiles(request)
243	        for (const change of changes) {
244	            const { fromPath, onCommitted, onPersisted, saveReference } = change
245	            const { card, file } = serializedChanges.get(change) as SerializedChange
246	            const current = this.pendingChanges.get(fromPath)
247	            if (current === change) {
248	                this.pendingChanges.delete(fromPath)
249	                this.pendingMessagesByPath.delete(fromPath)
250	            } else if (current && file.path !== fromPath) {
251	                this.pendingChanges.delete(fromPath)
252	                this.pendingChanges.set(file.path, { ...current, fromPath: file.path, moveSource: true })
253	                const messages = this.pendingMessagesByPath.get(fromPath)
254	                this.pendingMessagesByPath.delete(fromPath)
255	                if (messages) this.pendingMessagesByPath.set(file.path, messages)
256	            }
257	            if (card) markdownParsingService.acknowledgeSerializedCard(card, file)
258	            saveReference?.acknowledge()
259	            onPersisted?.()
260	            onCommitted?.(fromPath, file.path)
261	        }
262	        if (this.pendingChanges.size === 0) this.pendingBranch = null
263	        this.dispatchEvent(new Event(COMMIT_BATCHER_PENDING_CHANGED_EVENT))
264	        await this.cardOperations.pushCommittedFiles(request)
265	    }
266	
267	    private createCommitMessage() {
268	        const messages = [...this.pendingMessagesByPath.values()].flat()
269	        const distinctMessages = [...new Set(messages)]
270	        if (distinctMessages.length === 1) return distinctMessages[0]
271	
272	        const body = distinctMessages.map((message) => `- ${message}`).join('\n')
273	
274	        return `Update ${this.pendingChanges.size} files\n\n${body}`
275	    }
276	
277	    private createFlushCallback() {
278	        return () => {
279	            void this.flush().catch((error: unknown) => {
280	                this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(COMMIT_BATCHER_FLUSH_FAILED_EVENT, { detail: error }))
281	            })
282	        }
283	    }
284	
285	    private clearScheduledDelay() {
286	        if (this.scheduledDelayId === null) return
287	
288	        window.clearTimeout(this.scheduledDelayId)
289	        this.scheduledDelayId = null
290	    }
291	}
